records.english: {SPEAKER:94}You're set on it, huh? Just for you, then.{PAD}
records.speaker: Guildmaster acting as the cliff guide;original94 presentation state
records.context: Lil has just insisted she will climb the cliff despite the dangerous path. The guide recognizes her determination and agrees as a personal favor. The following original record says he will guide her to the cliff and asks her to bring a map. Current V820 actually displays the unchanged Japanese under the Guildmaster portrait/caption.
records.source_meaning: The guide observes that Lil's resolve is firm, then says he is doing this specifically for her as a favor.
records.localization_note: Use an informal, gruff acknowledgment and a conversational offer of a favor. Set on it conveys firm resolve; just for you preserves the personal motivation. No family relationship, rank or promise to perform Lil's climb is invented. One logical paragraph;the encoder owns the automatic break and protected continuation. Existing route profile94 and actual native prefix consumption are verified.
